newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares in doldrums after recent highs.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares in doldrums after recent highs.

text.p: Lithuanian shares were still stuck in the doldrums after the hectic market sessions of last month with prices easing slightly in light trade, dealers said.
Traders said market players were on the sidelines at the moment, seeing the market as fully-valued after last month's sharp gains.
The group A index fell by 58.22 points and overall central market volume turnover was just over 1.3 million litas.
Investors are also waiting for the 1996 results from banks, usually the most traded stocks on the market.
Trade in bank stocks was dull today, with total bank sector turnover at a mere 41,000 litas.
Only the Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company saw any significant activity as its price rose by 9.24 percent to 8.75 litas on trade of 216,000 litas.
Bloc trades worth almost 900,000 litas were made while volume on the secondary T-bill market was 295,000 litas.
